# sq_

> Browser-only 3D squash on a WSF court — Rapier physics, two-button controls, PARS-11 best-of-3.

## Play

- [Play sq_](https://sq.perniemann.com/): live game (WebGL + JavaScript required)

## Docs

- [How to play](https://github.com/perniemann/sq/blob/main/docs/HOW-TO-PLAY.md): controls and PARS scoring
- [Repository](https://github.com/perniemann/sq): source on GitHub

## Brand

- [Lockup](https://sq.perniemann.com/sq-lockup.svg): sq_ wordmark + mark
- [Favicon](https://sq.perniemann.com/sq-favicon.svg): square mark
